notes.title: We just announced our next game: RECUR!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Big news: we’ve just revealed our next game! Since “A Juggler’s Tale” launched back in 2021, we’ve been quietly pouring our hearts into something new—and we can’t wait for you to finally get a glimpse of it.
Introducing RECUR, a cinematic puzzle-platformer with a time-bending mechanic. If you enjoyed the world and storytelling of “A Juggler’s Tale,” we’re confident you’ll love this!

[previewyoutube=P2TVqmdZYUc;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2595260/

RECUR's time mechanic follows a very simple rule: 
➡️ Walking right: Into the future 
⬅️ Walking left: Into the Past
↕️ Front or back: Time frozen
We use this rule to build complex puzzle situations and fascinating moments, but also on the grand scale to tell our story. 

Sounds interesting?
You’re just an average postman, but today is anything but average. It’s the end of the world and you suddenly have the power to control time itself. By moving forwards or backwards, you alone control the flow of time to solve problems, change outcomes, and discover secrets as you try to save the world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37048490/8718f3e02a642b3ba4b39f207354fc6d36cf0364.gif
You need more than just reflexes to save the world: you’ll need to use your new time-bending abilities to solve puzzles and traverse gargantuan obstacles. Explore a world falling apart in your quest to put things right. Or left. 
How did you get your powers? Why is the world ending? Unravel the secrets of RECUR as you discover a rich and engaging story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37048490/7ba1ef64aab86ae628702ae27fbe03fb15056da3.gif

Our small team has been working very hard on RECUR and we can't wait to hear your feedback. If you like what you see, please consider adding the game to your Steam Wishlist - it will help us a lot! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2595260/

Thanks for checking this out and have a great week! 

The kaleidoscube Team

About A Juggler's Tale:

Lead Abby the string puppet through a bruised, but beautiful fairy tale world in this cinematic adventure. Solve riddles, evade traps and shake off pursuers on the way to find freedom. Can Abby take control of her fate with all the strings attached?

Features:


 Make use of the puppet’s strings in unique puzzles, find your way around obstacles, cross raging rivers, sneak through bandit camps and make it past dangerous traps to find freedom.

notes.title: A Juggler's Tale is out now for PC and Consoles
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

today is the big day and we are thrilled to get the news out:
 
A Juggler's Tale is now available for PC, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox and Nintendo Switch! 

We've come a long way ever since the game started out as a humble student project – it’s really a dream come true to finally see A Juggler's Tale in stores, ready for you to explore its bruised, but beautiful world! 

We'd like to thank every one of you for following and supporting us along the way!

To show you a little more of our poetic puppeteering platformer, so here's our release trailer in which you meet some furry friends: 

[previewyoutube=4oLYC__IClc;full][/previewyoutube]

Will you join Abby on her journey through a grim fairy tale world?
To get you untangled and ready to play, here's where to find A Juggler's Tale on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252830/A_Jugglers_Tale/

If you buy A Juggler's Tale and and enjoy playing it, please consider to leave a review on your favorite store and to spread the word on social media. It would help us a lot!

And if you want to share your feedback with us, you can do so on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or the Steam Community Hub.

We can't wait to find out how you like our game!

Take care
– Dominik, Steffen, Enzio & Elias (kaleidoscube)
Benjamin, Rebekka, Frieder, Alexandra & Julia (Mixtvision)

notes.title: About "A Juggler's Tale"
notes.content:
“A Juggler’s Tale” is an atmospheric 3D sidescroller set in a medieval puppet theater play.

Abby the string puppet flees from her captors into freedom and adventure: a world of beauty and wonder - but also danger! She finds herself in a war-torn, medieval fairytale, surrounded by ravaged, starving citizens and hunted by the relentless cut-throat, Tonda. Who can she trust? Can she avoid the traps and betrayal? Despite dangling from her threads, Abby learns that she can still influence her destiny - if only by winning over the audience.

Help Abby navigate a traumatized, yet hauntingly beautiful world. Lead her forward through riddles and around traps, evade her pursuers and find - perhaps - freedom!

Step into Abby's shoes and experience what it means to be hanging on a thread: 
Download the demo of "A Juggler's Tale" for free during Steam Game Festival, June 6-14!


Care for a look behind the scenes? Find out more about the game and the team:


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=trnYhNaTwFw

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6-KKEQ0flVs

https://youtu.be/Ly0xLJD7niw

notes.title: A story of hope and empowerment coming 2021
notes.content:
Allow us to put you in the shoes of Abby the string puppet, a talented artiste held captive at a circus. Longing for freedom, Abby flees from captivity, but soon has to realize that her fate isn’t completely in her own hands. Will she be able to take control of her destiny and make a difference with all the strings attached?

We have been working hard on our game for years now and are beyond happy to take this next step towards releasing it. We have partnered with Mixtvision who will help us bring A Juller's Tale to PC and consoles in 2021.

Wishlist our 3D side-scrolling adventure about Abby the marionette who tries to find her way to freedom now!

Set in a marionette theater, the acting characters are literally attached to the puppet master and narrator named Jack. Their bond is visible and tangible in the shape of strings: These strings prevent characters from walking beneath obstacles, for example, but they also offer a kind of safety: falling into a gaping abyss while hanging on strings is equally impossible. A Juggler’s Tale explores the string puppets’ relationship to the narrator, while making clever use of the underlying puppet play principles in its puzzles. 

Watch the announcement trailer:
https://youtu.be/nEHGfK1chjY
A Juggler’s Tale’s world of grim beauty already attracted attention at events like Gamescom or AdventureX and received numerous awards like the Game Connection Europe “Grand Award” 2019 and the German Computer Game Award "Best Newcomer Prototype" 2019. The game by German studio kaleidoscube is one of the finalists at the 2020 Independent Games Festival awards for Best Student Game - fingers crossed! 

Key Features:
 fascinating puzzles using the unique puppets’ strings gameplay mechanics 
 an intense story of hope and empowerment
 a unique, visually impressive game environment that blurs the boundary between puppet theater and “reality”
 a beautiful and grim fairy tale world
